entries.title: Make your AI agents survive an audit
entries.thesis: Enterprises are deploying agentic AI far faster than they are governing it, and in regulated industries that gap is an audit exposure. An operator with four tours of regulated-industry automation can sell 'make your AI agents survive an audit' faster than the Big 4 can productize it.

supportingEvidence.claim: Only 21% of enterprises have mature agentic-AI governance; AI skills gap is the top barrier; 74% expect moderate AI-agent use by 2027
supportingEvidence.source: Deloitte, State of AI in the Enterprise 2026

supportingEvidence.claim: Vertex Pharmaceuticals hiring Principal Analyst, CGT Agentic Solutions, $142.8K-$214.2K, posted 2026-06-01 (Boston)
Liberty Mutual hiring Intelligent Systems Solutions Engineer, $145K-$257K, posted 2026-04-09 (Boston)
